summary: Account deletion revokes access with a durable request, then a dedicated generation-fenced controller performs retryable cleanup and final deletion.
invariants: Deletion admission atomically deactivates the account, advances authentication/deletion generations and persists an idempotent deletion request.
The request returns accepted status without waiting for external cleanup; a restart-safe controller claims pending or expired requests.
Controller work requires dedicated database authority, owner/generation identity and claim fencing; PostgreSQL claims use SKIP LOCKED.
External cleanup failure is retryable and cannot be reported as completed deletion.
Final cleanup preserves the account deletion generation fence and durable cleanup journal boundaries.
forbidden: Treating an API 202 response as completed deletion.
Completing deletion after failed credential or artifact cleanup.
Treating a cancelled asyncio.to_thread wait as proof that its filesystem thread stopped.
